title: Catchplate Controller Receipt Contract v11
description: Closed, authenticated, content-addressed controller receipt. PASS exists only after current final authorization, clean destruction, an independent terminal seal, and atomic single-consumer pipeline commit. Every other accepted outcome is terminal and permanently non-passing.

u64.description: Canonical unsigned 64-bit integer encoded as exactly 20 zero-padded decimal digits. Native verification rejects lexicographic values greater than 18446744073709551615.

positiveU64.description: Canonical nonzero unsigned 64-bit integer encoded as exactly 20 zero-padded decimal digits.

rfc3339.description: UTC RFC3339 with seconds and optional 1-9 fractional digits. Native verification performs strict calendar validation and rejects leap-second, offset, normalization, and impossible-date forms.

receiptPreAllocationFrame.description: Closed mirror of the fixed 256-byte controller-to-client frame validated before receipt-body allocation or reading.

signature.description: Exact duplicate of the v11 request primitive. The same recomputed key leaf resolves the verification key and authorizes the role.

immutablePageReference.description: Digest-only reference to an immutable typed page. Page bytes are not duplicated in the receipt.

nonAuthorizingLegacyPageShapeCatalog.description: Historical concrete page payload catalog only. Native verification MUST NOT resolve an immutablePageReference to any of these flat shapes; every authorizing resolution uses resolvedPagedLeafPage.

signedObjectReference.description: Normative typed reference. The resolved signed object is included once as structured data; raw canonical bytes are not duplicated.

x-canonical-v11.versioning: This schema defines contractVersion 11 only. Every other version or domain is rejected; there is no compatibility mode.
x-canonical-v11.primitive: JCS means RFC 8785 canonical JSON encoded as UTF-8. LEN_BYTES(P) is the exact unsigned count of octets in byte string P before JSON or base64url representation; it is range-checked as a schema u64. LEN64BE(part) is the exactly 8-byte unsigned big-endian length of part and is used only to frame arbitrary LF11 parts. D20(value) is the exactly 20 ASCII bytes of a schema u64 after canonical validation and is the sole encoding of LEN_BYTES(P), an exact canonical byte length, or any other schema u64 inside a digest preimage. LF11(tag,parts...) = UTF8('catchplate/controller/v11/') || LEN64BE(UTF8(tag)) || UTF8(tag) ||, for each part in order, LEN64BE(part) || part. H11(tag,parts...) is lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256(LF11(tag,parts...)). HEX consumes exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters as 32 bytes. No implicit coercion is permitted.
x-canonical-v11.u64: All u64 fields are 20 ASCII digits, zero padded. Parse without floating point and reject values lexicographically greater than 18446744073709551615.
